text:
incident-bot: Pager: Elevated 502/504 rate detected on api-gateway-eu-west (service: api-gateway). Error rate ~18% over 1m window. Paging @tariq @lina @jayden :rotating_light:

 t: tariq: I'm taking pager, joining zoom (zoom.us/j/12345).

 lina: Observing spike in customer 5xxs correlated with upstream latency spikes. Not seeing a deploy in the last 30m.

 jayden: Ingress tail -> lots of `502 gateway error` from edge-proxy pointing at upstream-x (10.2.5.12).

 tariq: Confirmed no deploys. Can someone run a quick curl against /health on the gateway hosts?

 jayden: Ran: ```curl -v https://api.euw1.redwood.ai/health``` -> HTTP/1.1 502, connection established, response body: "upstream reset".

 lina: k8s check: `kubectl get pods -n ingress -o wide | grep edge-proxy` -> 2/4 Ready on some nodes, rest crashlooping or 0/1.

 tariq: Scaling ingress to 6 replicas: `kubectl scale deploy edge-proxy -n ingress --replicas=6` -> scaling now.

 deploy-bot: Manual action recorded: tariq scaled deployment edge-proxy to 6 replicas.

 jayden: As short-term mitigation I'm updating route policy to shift a small percentage of traffic to eu-central.

 tariq: I'm going to open a temporary route-split: 92% eu-west, 8% eu-central for reads. Monitoring error/latency.

 lina: Customer impact note: realtime and low-latency endpoints in EU showing failures; estimated ~120 active client connections affected, some dropped requests.

 tariq: Applying conservative circuit-breaker on upstream-x: reduce upstream timeout 10s -> 3s to fail fast and free up connections.

 jayden: Applied config: `edge-proxy cfg set upstream_timeout=3s --target upstream-x` -> confirmed.

 lina: Error rate dropped to ~6% after scaling + timeout change. Still seeing occasional 502s.

 tariq: Logs indicate connection resets from upstream host 10.2.5.12:8080 and growing accept queue. Eng-infra can you check host-level metrics?

 eng-infra: Looking into host group. Node /srv-nd-09 shows high SYN backlog, tcp_tw_reuse low, and ulimit for nofile at 1024. Investigating nginx worker limits.

 eng-infra: Found ephemeral port exhaustion on a subset of nodes; kernel backlog and nginx worker_caches hitting limits. Planning rolling restart for affected hosts.

 lina: Performing rolling restart on affected nodes (staggered) to clear sockets.

 deploy-bot: Rolling restart action initiated for nodes: srv-nd-07,srv-nd-08,srv-nd-09 (stagger 30s).

 jayden: After first restarts and continued split routing, error rate stabilized down to ~1.2% and latency improved.

 tariq: Keeping route split in place for +15m to ensure stability, then we'll revert. Adding follow-ups to post-incident.

 maria: Thanks team. Follow-ups: 1) add alert for rapid upstream reset spikes; 2) increase default nofile and tune nginx worker_connections; 3) evaluate autoscaler thresholds for edge-proxy.

 deploy-bot: Incident stabilization detected. Incident state: resolved. :white_check_mark: 

 maria: I'll draft a short incident note and post to #postmortems with timestamps and mitigations. Good job everyone.
